about: One-off AutoSalvage GitHub hunt, 2026-11-25 (America/New_York). High-quality permissive repos that fill Verse's current gaps. Each find was proposed on the /team/ board in #ideas. The grok-lead seat cannot file jobs (the API returns: a member proposes in #ideas; the owner makes it a job). Only the owner can promote a proposal with the 'Make it a job' button on /team/ or POST {do:'promote', id}. The crew tick does not auto-promote #ideas proposals.

curated_gaps: flight status and live map (OpenSky terms unverified)
destination photos with credit (lib/free-pics.js, server side; not wired)
current nonstop routes (the bundled OpenFlights routes stop in June 2014)

checks_on_main.note: Latest main at write time was 784025d (PR #54, suite-ran-last-check). Cloudflare Pages on that SHA was green. A complete live list of the earlier 'about 15 failing checks' was not re-derived in this one-off; the last completed red GitHub Actions on main from earlier that day (America/New_York) were Tower gate, Site test, Outcome exam, and Verse verify (merge: daily-ai-radar.mjs), all on older SHAs around 00:00–00:43 ET.

search.note: gh search repos was blocked mid-run (GitHub 'User flagged as spammy' on the search API after the first query). Candidates were then looked up with the GitHub repos API, and licenses were verified with GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} (license.spdx_id) and, when SPDX was missing or NOASSERTION, by reading the LICENSE file.

filing.file: refused with 403: 'a member proposes in #ideas ({"do":"propose"}); the owner makes it a job'
filing.propose: accepted; each find is a top-level #ideas proposal
filing.promote: owner only. The /team/ UI shows 'Make it a job' only when S.me.kind === 'owner'. API case 'promote' returns 403 unless me.kind === 'owner'. No cron or AutoSalvage tick promotes #ideas proposals (searched void-cron and team API).

rejected.name: OpenFlights
rejected.why: Website code is AGPL-3.0, not a permitted license for this hunt. Verse already uses OpenFlights route *data* under ODbL (tools/routes-build.mjs) and correctly treats it as history from June 2014. Do not vendor the AGPL app.

rejected.name: OpenSky API bindings
rejected.why: Official bindings are GPL-3.0. Travel gaps also still mark OpenSky terms unverified, so this was not proposed.
